Name: (CP) Blue Sebastian Recolour
Author: TinyRat95
Description:
A simple mod that replaces Sebastians weird default "biro-ink" purple.
It's now deep blue but he has dark red shorts at the beach :D
(Also fixed the overly-wide shoulders in some portraits)

Made to work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher

[/url]Originally made for personal use, but I hope someone else might enjoy it too :)

Lastly, if it's not Nexus, it's not me.

Thanks x
